load_runner_toml_config: load and validate a Gaia2 runner TOML config file from a given path
create_TargetConfig: create a TargetConfig dataclass to define scenario, dataset, splits, and subset manifest settings
create_AgentConfig: create an AgentConfig dataclass to define container image, runtime, provider, and model settings
create_JudgeConfig: create a JudgeConfig dataclass to define the judge model, provider, and API key settings
create_RunnerTomlConfig: create a RunnerTomlConfig dataclass that aggregates target, agent, judge, and run configuration
